newsitem.title: USA: CUC holders to sell 16.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: CUC holders to sell 16.5 mln shares.

text.p: CUC International Inc said Monday its shareholders filed to offer up to 16.5 million common shares.

Of the total, 13,200,000 common shares are being offered in the United States and 3,300,000 are being offered in the international market, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The offering is being made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, and Smith Barney Inc.

Selling shareholders include vice chairman Robert Davidson and director Janice Davidson. Stock was also being offered from five Davidson trusts and selling shareholders as a group, according to the filing.
